title: API identity and application security
subtitle: Carry trusted user identity through routes, tools, workers, and streams.
goal: Carry trusted identity from browser to business service
intro: Authentication identifies a caller; every resource access still needs a permission decision.
terms: Unwanted requests using ambient browser credentials
case: A user asks an agent about another customer's request ID.
The service denies the lookup regardless of what the model proposes.
A valid-looking identifier is not proof of ownership.
